conexao.comentario: Subconjunto rapido (C1, C2, C5). Senha vazia: defina a variavel de ambiente PGPASSWORD.

indices.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_docstj_fts_gin ON documentos_stj USING gin (busca_tsv)

cenarios.consulta: SELECT codigo FROM documentos_stj WHERE busca_tsv @@ to_tsquery('portuguese', 'habeas & corpus') LIMIT 20

indices.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_docstj_fts_gist ON documentos_stj USING gist (busca_tsv)

cenarios.consulta: SELECT codigo FROM documentos_stj WHERE busca_tsv @@ to_tsquery('portuguese', 'habeas & corpus') LIMIT 20

indices.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_docstj_emb_ivfflat ON documentos_stj USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (lists = 100)

cenarios.consulta: SELECT codigo FROM documentos_stj ORDER BY embedding <=> (SELECT embedding FROM documentos_stj WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY codigo LIMIT 1) LIMIT 20
